protocol.go_bar: GO only if, on EACH of BTC and ETH, at least one config (bar grid x horizon) has Spearman IC > 0, directional permutation p < 0.05, block-bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0, at least min_usable_pairs_per_config usable pairs, and pooled BH-FDR rejects that (underlying, config); else NO-GO CONFIRMED (PASS).

floor.note: EVAL-81 consumes each underlying's causal options order-flow states (surface snapshots for spot + straddle quotes, option trade tape for signed-aggressor flow) and the real perp candles for the forward signed return. It composes the sealed EVAL-71 surface floor (applied to EACH underlying, reused verbatim, neither weakened) with an options order-flow adequacy floor (>= min_oflow_states_per_underlying priceable per-bar order-flow states per underlying). This is NOT the EVAL-64 options-surface snapshot floor, which governs the EVAL-67/68/69 ladder and is untouched here.
